entry.title: The First Report Landed at 6am. One Number Was Wrong.
entry.summary: Post #6 covered the architecture. This post covers what happened when it ran for real — and the data-quality problem it quietly exposed.

entry.title: Inside the Architecture: How an AI CFO Agent Actually Gets Built
entry.summary: Most descriptions of AI CFO agents are too abstract. Here's the actual plumbing — what connects to what, and what runs without anyone pressing a button.

entry.title: CEO Calls Friday at 4pm. The Accountant Hasn't Closed the Month.
entry.summary: This conversation happens often, in many companies under 200 people. It's not the accountant's fault. It's a systems problem.

entry.title: Plenty of Cash on Wednesday. Missed Payroll on Friday.
entry.summary: A company with €2M revenue can look completely healthy on Monday and be in crisis by Friday. Not because they're losing money — but because no one was watching.

entry.title: 50 People. €15M Revenue. 1 Accountant. This Is Normal.

entry.title: An AI CFO Agent Is Not a Chatbot. Here's What It Actually Is.
